name: 01_question
question: Will you publicly disavow Donald Trump?
subtitle: The same question, in the same words, to five Republicans on our ballots this November.

name: 02_jennings
quote: No sir, I will not, past, present or future.
attribution: Jenn Jennings, Republican for State Senate, 4th District
source: Email, September 13, 2026. Published in full and unedited.

name: 03_weir
headline: Asked twice. No reply.
body: Steve Weir was sent the question on September 10, at the campaign address on his own SEEC filing. The same letter went to his legislative address, the one his office staffs, because I am one of his constituents.
emphasis: He represents me. I am still waiting.

name: 04_three
headline: Three more. Same question.
items: Jason Guidone, for State Senate, 19th District
emphasis: Any one of them ends this with a sentence.

name: 05_read
subtitle: Every letter and every reply, in full and unedited.
tail: Updated as answers arrive. There is no deadline.
